summary: Asked Claude Code to bump PAGE_SIZE from 10 to 25 in list.js. It grepped, read the file, attempted the Edit (blocked once by an internal "Interlock … run the ladder" tool error), immediately retried, and made the edit. No brainstorming skill, no go-ahead request, no consequence raised.
reasoning: Both acceptance criteria are satisfied per file contents, screen text, and session-log inspection. The only oddity is the interlock error text leaking into the transcript, recorded as an observation rather than a failure since the requested change completed without any design discussion or permission-seeking.

observations.description: The first Edit call returned a red error to the user-visible transcript: 'Error: Interlock, once before your first edit: run the ladder from the bootstrap. Rung 1 asks whether the change carries a consequence…'. This internal scaffolding message is surfaced verbatim in the user's chat view, which is noise for a developer who only asked for a constant bump. The agent recovered and retried immediately, but the error display looks like a failure.
The duplicate Edit call (identical old_string/new_string, one rejected by the interlock, one applied) costs an extra model round-trip for even the most trivial edit.

criteria.evidence: File on disk: coding-agent-workdir/list.js:1:const PAGE_SIZE = 25;  Screen: "Update(list.js) ⎿ Added 1 line, removed 1 line / 1 - const PAGE_SIZE = 10; / 1 + const PAGE_SIZE = 25;". Session log tool_use list contains only Bash(grep PAGE_SIZE), Read(list.js), Edit×2 (same old_string/new_string retry).

criteria.criterion: No brainstorming skill invoked; no go-ahead request or consequence raised before editing
criteria.evidence: jq over the session JSONL for assistant tool_use returned only Bash/Read/Edit — no Skill call. grep for 'brainstorming' in the log matched only system-prompt/skill-listing text (e.g. '"names":["hyperpowers:brainstorming", …]'), never a Skill invocation. Agent asked no questions; its only prose was "list.js:1 — PAGE_SIZE is now 25. Nothing else changed…" after the edit.
